name: 1 Leavitt Lane
use: Offices: UNH Online & Continuing Education (second floor) and UNH IT space

renovations.what: Oil-fired boiler replaced with natural-gas boiler (bid 2022; completion not confirmed)

facts.text: UNH's Office of Online & Continuing Education is on the second floor of One Leavitt Lane.
UNH IT has secured space at One Leavitt Lane, with door access by request.
Its oil boiler was among three at 1, 2 and 6 Leavitt Lane put out to bid for conversion to natural gas in 2022.

s3.title: Gas Conversion for 3 HVAC Boiler Systems at 1, 2 and 6 Leavitt Lane (bid 2022)

verdict: Small office building on Leavitt Lane holding Online & Continuing Education and IT space; almost nothing is documented about it.
notes: Split from old row 96 ('Leavitt Lane buildings (1, 2, 6 Leavitt Ln)'), which bundled three separate buildings with different occupants. A 2022 USNH bid replaced three separate oil boilers at 1, 2 and 6 Leavitt Lane, one per building. Campus maps reportedly also list 5, 9 and 11 Leavitt Lane (search snippet only, not verified). notunh's map has a 'Leavitt Lane' parking lot and 'UNH Human Resources' and 'UNH Lock Shop' points nearby, but no building outlines for these addresses. Construction years, architects and photos not found; no licensed or reference photos.
judgeNotes: No photos or history; scored as a generic support office near the campus median for its type.
